title: There's a Hole in Your Vision Right Now. Try This

scenes.text: There's a hole in your vision right now. Try this.
Close your right eye. Hold both thumbs up at arm's length, side by side. Stare at the left one.
scenes.keywords: person holding thumbs up arms outstretched

scenes.text: Now slowly slide your right thumb outward. At some point, it vanishes.
Where the optic nerve leaves your eye, there are no light sensors at all. Just a blank patch.
You never notice. Your other eye covers it, and your brain paints in the surroundings.
A hole in your vision, filled in with a guess. Now try the other eye.

description:
There's a hole in your vision right now, and your brain is hiding it.
Each eye has a blind spot where the optic nerve leaves the retina and there are no photoreceptors. Close one eye, stare at one thumb at arm's length and slide the other sideways, and it disappears; your brain fills the gap with the surrounding scene.
Did your thumb vanish? How far did you have to move it?
thumbnail_text: THERE'S A HOLE IN YOUR VISION
first_comment: Did your thumb disappear? Now try it on a word on this screen: the letters around it will seem to close the gap. Your brain just made that up.
